create_htmlbook: create an Htmlbook instance with a title to generate an HTML page from text and matplotlib figures
add_section_htmlbook: add a numbered section with a name to the Htmlbook and update the table of contents
add_plot_htmlbook: add a matplotlib figure embedded as SVG or base64 image into the Htmlbook
add_details_htmlbook: add a collapsible details section with a summary and preformatted text to the Htmlbook
save_htmlbook_to_file: save the Htmlbook as an indented HTML string to a file with an .html extension
